articles.title: No people contact with Pakistan till terror ends, Parliamentary Panel told
articles.summary: Indian government officials stated that people-to-people contact with Pakistan is possible only in an atmosphere free from terrorism and violence. This reiterates India's consistent stance: normalisation of relations and cross-border exchanges depend on Pakistan creating a conducive, secure environment by curbing terror activities. This emphasizes India's priority on security before any significant progress in bilateral ties.

articles.title: CPI(ML) demands probe into Bhojpur firing case
articles.summary: A survey reveals 50% of American adults under 50 may be receiving incorrect medical advice from YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, highlighting the global challenge of health misinformation. Conversely, England has achieved a significant public health milestone by reportedly reducing cervical cancer deaths to zero among young women, showcasing the impact of effective health initiatives.

articles.title: Fifa bans football club's submarine badge on flag
articles.summary: Little, heading to Boston for England's Tuesday match against Ghana, expressed strong disbelief regarding an unspecified action, calling it 'a little bit harsh.' Little stated, 'I couldn't believe it really, it's a little bit harsh that they've done it for something like that.' The article offers no further details on the incident that prompted this reaction.
